pages.title: Iesnium Golem
pages.text: An Iesnium Golem is a direct upgrade from a regular Iron Golem, this new version is much stronger and invulnerable. $(br)Only a player can dismiss them, by hitting while crouched, returning as a $(item)Fragile Soul Gem$().$(br)

pages.title: Not a Familiar
pages.text: The Iesnium Golem Chapter is part of the Familiar Category of this book because of the similarities, however a golem is not exactly a familiar since it does not have an owner.$(br2)As such, they also cannot be stored in a $(item)Familiar $()

pages.title: Not a Familiar
pages.text: Ring$() or in a $(item)Soul Gem$(). You can, however, dispense with them as stated on the previous page.$(br)
